title: Regenerative credit draft validation and idempotency
status: source repair and focused checks pass; capability not accepted
changes: Rejects non-finite and non-positive withheld amounts before opening a database cursor.
Exact idempotency-key retries return the existing credit record without another insert.
Conflicting key reuse is rejected when immutable request fields differ, including location, contributor, source, amount, unit, redemption purpose, or creator.
Credit proposals remain draft-only and transaction commit/rollback remains caller-owned.

verification.ruff: python3 -m ruff check services/capital/credit.py tests/test_capital_accounting.py: passed

scope_limits: Tests use mocked database connections; no candidate, legacy, or disposable database was contacted.
The change does not verify credit balance parity, custody, settlement, or redemption workflows.
